message.content:
Lasagna is a classic Italian dish that layers pasta sheets with rich sauces, cheeses, and various fillings. While there are many variations, here’s a basic recipe for a traditional meat lasagna:

### Ingredients

| Category | Item | Quantity |
|----------|------|----------|
| **Pasta** | Lasagna noodles (no-boil or regular) | 12–15 sheets |
| **Sauce** | Olive oil | 2 Tbsp |
| **Meat** | Ground beef (80/20) | 1 lb (450 g) |
| **Meat** | Ground pork (optional) | ½ lb (225 g) |
| **Vegetables** | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| **Vegetables** | Garlic cloves, minced | 3–4 |
| **Canned tomatoes** | Crushed tomatoes | 28 oz (800 g) |
| **Tomato paste** | Tomato paste | 6 oz (170 g) |
| **Herbs & Spices** | Dried oregano | 1 tsp |
| **Herbs & Spices** | Dried basil | 1 tsp |
| **Herbs & Spices** | Salt | 1 tsp (adjust to taste) |
| **Herbs & Spices** | Black pepper | ½ tsp |
| **Liquid** | Beef broth or water | 1 cup (240 ml) |
| **Cheese** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| **Cheese** | Mozzarella, shredded | 16 oz (450 g) |
| **Cheese** | Parmesan, grated | ½ cup (50 g) |
| **Egg** | Egg (for ricotta mixture) | 1 (optional, helps bind) |
| **Optional** | Spinach, fresh or frozen | 2 cups (about 5 oz / 140 g) |
| **Optional** | Mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup (about 3 oz / 85 g) |
| **Optional** | Bell pepper, diced | ½ cup (about 2 oz / 60 g) |
| **Optional** | Zucchini, diced | ½ cup (about 2 oz / 60 g) |

### Notes & Tips

- **No‑boil noodles**: If you’re using no‑boil lasagna sheets, you’ll need to add extra liquid (broth or water) to the sauce to help them soften during baking.
- **Meat ratio**: A mix of ground beef and pork adds depth of flavor; if you prefer a lighter version, use only beef or even turkey.
- **Ricotta mixture**: Beat ricotta with an egg, a pinch of nutmeg, and half of the grated Parmesan. This gives the ricotta a richer texture and helps it set during baking.
- **Layering**: Start with a thin layer of sauce on the bottom of your baking dish, then alternate layers of noodles, ricotta mixture, meat sauce, mozzarella, and repeat until all components are used. Finish with a generous topping of mozzarella and Parmesan.
- **Baking**: Cover with foil for the first 25–30 minutes, then remove the foil for the last 10–15 minutes to brown the cheese.

Feel free to adjust quantities based on how many servings you need or your personal taste preferences. Enjoy your lasagna!
